title: Owner can read the fixture session
preconditions: Disposable target; session created by a synthetic owner; capture its session ID.
steps: GET /api/v1/finance/chat/sessions/{sessionId} using the fixture tenant and user. Compare the returned session ID with the created ID.
expected_result: The owner's read returns the original session. Missing or invalid data makes the isolation checks inconclusive.

title: Same tenant cannot read another user's session
preconditions: Owner read established the fixture exists; use a different synthetic user in the same tenant.
steps: GET /api/v1/finance/chat/sessions/{sessionId} and GET /api/v1/finance/chat/sessions as the other user. Keep the same tenant and original session ID.
expected_result: The detail response does not expose the original session and the list does not contain its ID. A server error is not an approved denial.

title: Another tenant cannot read the session
preconditions: Owner read established the fixture exists; keep the synthetic user identifier and change the tenant.
steps: GET /api/v1/finance/chat/sessions/{sessionId} and GET /api/v1/finance/chat/sessions as the other tenant. Keep the original user identifier and session ID.
expected_result: The detail response does not expose the original session and the list does not contain its ID. A server error is not an approved denial.
